programme.title: Lääkärit vastaan internet
programme.desc: Miksi Tony sai jalkoihinsa voimakkaita kramppeja? Tänään lääkärit haastaa kolme teknologiatyöntekijää. Kuka löytää potilaalle oikean diagnoosin? Tietokilpailusarja, jossa toisistaan ottavat mittaa lääkärit ja tavalliset kansalaiset, joilla on apunaan internet.

programme.title: Sámi Lore
programme.desc: Nik Märak, kokki ja kondiittori, tarjoaa Staalo-maistiaisia luovien leivonnaistensa kautta. Hän näkee tarinoissa voiman, joka vahvistaa saamelaisia.

programme.title: Skavlan ja Ruotsi
programme.desc: Onko tasa-arvo jo saavutettu, ja kuinka tasa-arvoisia oikeastaan haluamme parisuhteidemme olevan? Asiasta keskustelevat ampumahiihtäjä Sebastian Samuelsson, realitytähti Urban Nyman, juristi ja entinen käsipalloammattilainen Linnéa Claeson, lehtikuningatar Amelia Adamo, kristillisdemokraattien europarlamentaarikko Alice Teodorescu Måwe sekä seksologi Malena Ivarsson. Juontaja: Fredrik Skavlan.

programme.title: Deittaavat daamit
programme.desc: Rita, 77, kirjoittaa elämänsä ensimmäisen seuranhakuilmoituksen lehteen. Maria pelaa treffikumppaninsa kanssa minigolfia. Erjan luo tulee kylään lapsenlapsi Alma, jonka kanssa puhutaan poikaystävistä ja Erjan unelmamiehestä. Daamit keskustelevat ulkonäöstä ja itseluottamuksesta.

programme.title: Kadonneet perijät
programme.desc: Aatelissuku ja isä, joka vaihtoi nimeään kolmesti. Kas siinäpä pulma, joka tekee Hans Christianin perinnöstä hankalan setvittävän Mettelle ja Adamille. He uppoutuvat isän mysteeriin: Miksi hänellä oli useita identiteettejä? Ja kenen pitäisi periä Hans Christian?

programme.title: Islantilaisia paikannimiä
programme.desc: Islantilainen muusikko Sigtryggur Baldursson kiertää maata ja selvittää asiantuntijoiden kanssa islantilaisten paikannimien syntyä. Osa 6/8. T: RUV, 2022

programme.title: Riistametsällä Pohjolassa
programme.desc: Osa 6/8. Kokki ja eränkävijä retkeilevät pohjoisen kauniissa luonnossa, pyytävät riistaa ja valmistavat siitä avotulella aterian. Se nautitaan villiyrttien, marjojen tai muiden luonnon antimien kera.

programme.title: Enkeleistä oudoin
programme.desc: Psykiatrinen sairaanhoitaja kohtaa entisen koulutoverinsa potilaana. Hoitaja alkaa kyseenalaistaa mielenterveyden käsitteitä ja hulluina pidettyjen potilaiden hoitomuotoja. Tarina sijoittuu 50-luvun Uuteen-Seelantiin ja on saanut inspiraationsa kirjailija Janet Framen elämästä. Kamariooppera kahdelle sopraanolle ja orkesterille. Libretto ja sävellys: kirjailija Georgia Jamieson Emms, säveltäjä Kenneth Young ja sopraano Anna Leese. Pääosissa Katherine Baillie ja Anna Leese. Christchurch Symphony Orchestraa johtaa Kenneth Young. Ohjaus: Rebecca Tansley.

programme.title: Tommi Kitti ja lopettamisen taito (S)
programme.desc: Tommi Kitti ja lopettamisen taito kertoo elämänmuutoksesta. Koreografi Valtteri Raekallio matkustaa Lapin erämaahan houkutellakseen mestarinsa harjoittamaan vanhan tanssiteoksen näyttämölle. Maamme merkittävimpiin tanssitaiteilijoihin kuuluva Kitti lopetti uransa vuonna 2012 ja on sen jälkeen asunut hirsimökissä Lapissa rekikoiria kasvattaen. Mikä saa ihmisen hylkäämään kaiken, mitä on rakentanut vuosikymmeniä? Milloin on oikea aika lopettaa - tai aloittaa jotakin aivan uutta?

programme.title: Olipa kerran televisio
programme.desc: Television pelättiin tyhmentävän ja turmelevan Suomen kansan. Toisaalta sen uskottiin kasvattavan meistä viisaampia. Molempia se tekikin, ja samalla se muutti suomalaisen tunne-elämän.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12) (S)
programme.desc: Cristóbal pyytää Leocadiaa kertomaan totuuden Ángelalle. Onko Martinan puuhakkuus vain veruke pitää etäisyyttä Adrianoon? Julietalla on kiistaa Ciron kanssa, mutta Julieta on päättänyt pitää puolensa.

programme.title: Màkari - Sisilian murhamysteerit (12)
programme.desc: Saverion serkku on kuollut auto-onnettomuudessa. Isä haluaa Saverion tulevan hautajaisiin, vaikka pojat eivät ole tavanneet vuosikymmeniin. Liittyykö kuolemaan jotain hämärää?

programme.title: Orpojen joulu (S)
programme.desc: Orpojen joulu -dokumentti on tekijänsä henkilökohtainen löytöretki. Anu matkustaa vieraaseen kaupunkiin etsimään isäänsä, josta on nähnyt vain valokuvan. Täyttyykö isän kokoinen aukko sielussa? Ohjaus Anu Kuivalainen. Tuotanto TaiK / Elokuvataiteen laitos

programme.title: Villit kokit
programme.desc: Ruotsalaiset ruokajulkkikset Erik Brännström ja Leila Lindholm, Lisa Lemke ja Erik Videgård sekä Zeina Mourtada ja Filip Poon kilpailevat kolmena joukkueena siitä, mikä pari valmistaa parasta ruokaa avotulella. Kilpailijoilla on tunti aikaa valmistaa sekä alkuruoka että lämmin pääruoka. Kisan juontaa Niklas Ekstedt.

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 17.55
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: BUU-klubben
programme.desc: Tänään katsomme yhdessä, mitä BUU-klubbenissa tapahtui kuluneella viikolla.

programme.title: Miia ja Roni (S)
programme.desc: Vietetään halloweenia, ja Roni saa ensimmäistä kertaa osallistua erilaisiin leikkeihin voittaakseen palkinnon. Miialla on vaikeaa löytää sopiva koodi.

programme.title: Lepplaxin hippi
programme.desc: Vuosien poissaolon jälkeen muusikko ja laulaja Charlotta Kerbs palaa lapsuudenkyläänsä Lepplaxiin ryhtyäkseen pyörittämään isovanhempiensa tilaa. Hän järjestää musiikkitapahtumia ja kohtaa haamuja menneisyydestä. Elämäntapansa vuoksi Charlotta tuntee poikkeavansa muista paikkakuntalaisista. Hän saa kuitenkin odottamatonta tukea kylätutkijoilta, jotka Lepplaxin historiaa tallentaessaan tarvitsevat uudet tilat arkistoilleen. Dokumentissa Kerbs tanssii metsässä, pitää talkoot ja järjestää Lufolk-festarit navetassa. Hän haluaa löytää oman paikkansa, jonka hän kokee menettäneensä lapsena.

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 19.30
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: Ruotsi tutkii
programme.desc: Onko toimittajallamme palomieheksi vaadittava fyysinen kunto? Tutkija Lasse ten Siethoff selittää, miten kolmeminuuttinen kuntotesti osoittaa, onko henkilöllä oikeat edellytykset työhön.

programme.title: Radion sinfoniaorkesterin konsertti (S)
programme.desc: Anja Bihlmaier, kapellimestari, Sergei Krylov, viulu. - Sofia Gubaidulina: Offertorium viululle ja orkesterille. Johannes Brahms (sov. Arnold Schönberg): Pianokvartetto g-molli, sovitus orkesterille. Viivästetty suora lähetys Musiikkitalosta.

programme.title: Kuolematon Eila Hiltunen
programme.desc: Sibelius-monumentti synnyttää yhden Suomen suurimmista patsaskiistoista. Eila Hiltusen abstrakti, teräsputkiin perustuva ehdotus saa osakseen pilkkaa. Lauttasaaren kylmä halli, 24 tonnia ruostumatonta terästä ja kuuden vuoden työ koettelevat taiteilijaa fyysisesti ja henkisesti. Monumentti paljastetaan yleisölle 1967. Eila hankkii keskiaikaisen kivitornin Italiasta.

programme.title: Elokuva: Marinadimestari (16)
programme.desc: Svend ja Bjarne kyllästyvät pomoonsa ja päättävät perustaa oman teurastusliikkeensä. Rankan alun jälkeen sähkövikaan liittyvä onnettomuus johtaa heidät kohti odottamatonta menestystä.

programme.title: BUU-klubben
programme.desc: Tänään katsomme BUU-klubbenin päivän jakson, ja lisäksi BUU-kinossa esitetään sarjoja Lunnin luontokoulu, Vedenalaisen maailman asukkaita ja Isadora Moon.

programme.title: BUU-klubben
programme.desc: Tänään katsomme BUU-klubbenin päivän jakson, ja lisäksi BUU-kinossa esitetään sarjoja Kasper ja Petra sekä Miia ja Roni.

programme.title: Kotijumppaa Sofian kanssa
programme.desc: Jumppaa SVT:n kotitreeneissä! Nyt keskitytään parantamaan liikkuvuutta. Ei suomenkielistä tekstitystä.

programme.title: Nuoret kilvoittelijat (S)
programme.desc: Loviisa tuli uskoon voidakseen vielä tavata kuolleen isoäitinsä. Kun Mezmur kuuntelee autossa gospelräppiä ja ajaa maaseudulla, Jumala istuu hänen vieressään. Kirkossa vierailevat koululaiset ihmettelevät, miksi naiset eivät voi mennä alttarille. Pääsiäinen lähestyy, ja Loviisa hankkii lankapuhelimen vähentääkseen puhelinriippuvuuttaan.

programme.title: Minä ja afroni
programme.desc: Naisen afrohiukset voivat herättää monenlaisia tunteita. Ne ovat paljon muutakin kuin vain hiukset. Afrohiukset ovat osa indentiteettiä ja voivat symboloida sortoa ja yhteenkuuluvuutta. Ennen kaikkea ne viestivät ylpeydestä. Ruotsalaisessa dokumentissa Minä ja afroni (Mitt afro och jag) lastenohjelmien juontaja Leila Trulsen, koripallotähti Amanda Zahui, artisti Jacqueline Mapei Cummings ja Nora Karltun kertovat kokemuksistaan ja suhteestaan omiin afrohiuksiinsa.

programme.title: På spåret
programme.desc: Malin Persson Giolito ja Ola Söderholm kohtaavat neljännen jakson voittajat kakkoslohkon ratkaisevassa ottelussa. Kristian Luuk juontaa, ja Fredrik Lindström on tuomarina. Musiikista vastaa Yttling Jazz, ja vieraileva artisti on Lisa Nilsson.

programme.title: Unelmakoti
programme.desc: Seurakuntatalo kirkon vieressä keskellä maaseutua Linköpingin ja Norrköpingin puolivälissä - siihen Jesper ja Felicia ihastuivat. Täällä kaikki laitetaan uuteen uskoon tyylillä ja taiteellisella leikkisyydellä. Gert pitää maalaiseleganssin ja kattomaalausten ajatuksista, mutta hänen mielestään portaat pitäisi siirtää näyttävälle paikalle keskelle taloa.

programme.title: Jumalanpalvelus: Kuoroteos Som när en farkost - Kuin alus - tunnelmallinen konsertti Viikin kirkossa
programme.desc: Pyhäinpäivänä kauniissa Viikin kirkossa kuullaan Håkan Wikmanin johtama kuoroteos Som när en farkost - Kuin alus. Esiintyjinä Marika Westerling (lausunta ja soololaulu), Gamelikörenin laulajat, Teppo Salakka (klarinetti), Curt Qvarnström (kontrabasso) ja Robi de Godzinsky (piano). Liturgian toimittaa ja hartauspuheen pitää Hilkka Olkinuora. Tv-ohjaaja: Rufus Hedengren.

programme.title: Äiti Maan palveluksessa
programme.desc: Voidaanko Itämeri pelastaa rehevöitymiseltä? Mitä meidän pitäisi asian eteen tehdä? Yrittäjä Joel Lindholm kertoo lyhyessä dokumenttielokuvassa hyvinvoivan Itämeren puolesta tehtävästä työstä.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12) (S)
programme.desc: Mihin asiaan Petra pyytää Martinalta taloudellista apua? Curro aprikoi mitä tehdä kuninkaalle osoitetun kirjeen kanssa - ja Ángela huokaisee helpotuksesta.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Carlo yllättää jälleen Marían ja Samuelin keskustelemassa keskenään. Cristóbal haluaa läheisemmän suhteen Ángelaan.

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12) (S)
programme.desc: Currolla ja Ángelalla on riitaa ja Leocadia käyttää välirikkoa hyväkseen. Carlolla on epäilyksensä Samuelin ja María suhteesta. Entä millainen on nyt Teresan ja Cristóbalin suhde?

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano (12)
programme.desc: Jacobolla on hämmentävää ilmoitettavaa. Kokit kiittävät Julietaa päivien piristämisestä. Pääsevätkö Curro ja Ángela sopuun?

programme.title: Kulttuuricocktail Kirjat
programme.desc: Taika Mannilan romaanissa Rakkauden rehab hoidetaan surullisia tyttöjä. Juhani Karila vie päähenkilönsä ihmissuden terapiavastaanotolle. Rachel Kushnerin Mars Room kuvaa kalifornialaisen naisvankilan outoa arkea.

programme.title: Elävä arkisto: Mannermainen muoti (S)
programme.desc: Eurooppalaisia mannekiineja saapuu Seutulan lentokentälle Helsinkiin. Lyhytelokuvassa neuvotaan, miten vaate etenee kaavoista valmiiksi puvuiksi. Lisäksi seurataan, kun mannekiinit piipahtavat Kalevala Korun myymälässä ostoksilla. Filmiseppo Oy 1957

programme.title: Studio 65
programme.desc: Toisen maailmansodan aikana Ruotsi vahvisti valmiuttaan. Kaikki aikuiset osallistuivat projektiin tavalla tai toisella, ja tuon ajan muistavia ihmisiä on yhä elossa. 99-vuotias Tage Nilsson kertoo kokemuksistaan. Onko taas aika varautua? Luvassa on pohdintaa ja käytännön vinkkejä.

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 17.55
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: Karmiva hirviö (7)
programme.desc: Pikkuinen ja suloinen hirviö Lari ei usko omaan karmivuuteensa, vaan pukeutuu karmeaan hirviöpukuun ollakseen pelottava. Eräänä halloweenina Lari jää jälkeen muista hirviöistä, eikä ehdikään lähteä ajoissa taikaportaalin kautta kotiin. Ihmisten maailmaan jumiin jäänyt Lari löytää uuden ystävän, Nean, joka auttaa Laria uskomaan itseensä - ja lopulta pääsemään kotiin.

programme.title: Pyhäinpäivän kynttilöiden sytytys
programme.desc: Pyhäinpäivänä sytytämme kynttilöitä kaipaamiemme ihmisten muistolle. Kynttilöiden sytytyksen lisäksi ohjelmassa nähdään tunnelmia Porvoon ja Helsingin hautausmailta, keskustellaan surusta Rune Särsin sekä Nicklas ja Sara Södön kanssa ja kuullaan viulisti Denice Djerassin rauhallista musiikkia. Ohjelman juontavat Amanda Audas-Kass ja Lucas Snellman. Voit osallistua ohjelmaan myös Yle Areenan chatissa.

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 19.30
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: Sportnytt
programme.desc: Urheilu-uutisia.

programme.title: Livet - suomenruotsalaisia tarinoita
programme.desc: Aito kohtaaminen toisen ihmisen kanssa vie aikaa ja voi vähän sattuakin, mutta auttaa meitä löytämään paikkamme. Näin uskoo Victoria Lindqvist, joka haluaa ihmisten kohtaavan toisensa elävässä elämässä aikana, jolloin moni piiloutuu ruudun taakse. Mutta missä kohtaamisia voisi tapahtua? Vaikkapa Victorian katon alla Tenholassa.

programme.title: Kuolematon Eila Hiltunen
programme.desc: Sibelius-monumentin jälkeen Eila Hiltunen jatkaa monumenttien tekemistä ulkomailla. Saudi-Arabiaan nousee Hiltusen suurin veistos, Auringonkukkapelto, Iraniin Palmulehto. Italiasta hankitun keskiaikaisen tornin remontoiminen osoittautuu mahdottomaksi, niin myös siitä luopuminen. Kuolinvuoteellaan 2003 Hiltunen toteaa pojanpojalleen: Velvollisuus suoritettu.

programme.title: Ruotsalaiset designklassikot
programme.desc: Tekstiilisuunnittelija Astrid Sampe oli ensimmäinen, joka lisäsi väriä ja kuvioita perinteiseen valkoiseen pöytäliinaan. Sampen luoma Linnelinjen-mallisto toi vallankumouksen ruotsalaisten liinavaatekaappeihin.

programme.title: Kino Klassikko: Rocky Horror Picture Show (12)
programme.desc: Tervehenkinen pariskunta Brad Majors ja Janet Weiss eksyvät jonnekin päin Ohiota ja hakeutuvat suojaan läheiseen linnaan. Siellä he kohtaavat tohtori Frank-N-Furterin hullun transvestiittitiedemiehen, hänen pahaa aikovan palvelijansa Riff Raffin sekä salaperäisen Magentan.

programme.title: Uusi Kino: Kaikki hyvin (S)
programme.desc: Kaksi Suomessa asuvaa albanialaista miehestä uskovat saavansa sydänkohtauksia, vaikka kyse on paniikkikohtauksista. Kun he alkavat hoitamaan vääriä diagnoosejaan kotikonstein, alkaa hallitsematon kierre. Elokuva on enemmän kuin tragikoominen tarina kieltämisestä ja peritystä maskuliinisuudesta. Se kantaa mukanaan toivoa siitä, ettemme ole yksin. O: Basha Troni T: Tetra Film Ab (Suomi 2026)

programme.title: Musta aukko (16)
programme.desc: Kerrostaloalueen asukkaat haaveilevat paremmasta elämästä ja tarttuvat tilaisuuteen, kun syreenipensaaseen ilmestyy mystisesti musta aukko. He joutuvat kohtaamaan avaruusolentoja, jättiläishämähäkin ja polvihousuisen pölynimurikauppiaan. Elokuva on katkeransuloinen ja absurdin koominen vertaus vaikeista ajoista, joiden keskellä elämme. O: Moonika Siimets T: Amrion, Elokuvayhtiö Aamu (Viro/Suomi 2024)

programme.title: Ylen aamu
programme.desc: 6.40 Euroopan raideliikenteen turvallisuus 6.54 Saksa varautuu viikonlopun mielenosoituksiin 7.09 Kanada ja EU haluavat lähentyä entisestään 7.14 Talous kasvaa, miksi asuntokauppa laahaa? 7.39 FI-Alert tuo vaaratiedotteet suoraan puhelimiin 7.44 Jälkiviisaat 8.24 Joensuun liikenneympyröistä otetaan nyt mallia 8.50 Vieraana Lounaonline 9.10 Mikä kauhussa kiehtoo? Studiossa Totti Toivonen ja Nina Svahn.

programme.title: Anne ja Anders Bhutanissa

Pienessä buddhalaisessa valtiossa onni, henkinen hyvinvointi ja kulttuuriset arvot asetetaan talouskasvun edelle. Anne ja Anders matkustavat Bhutaniin kokeakseen itse, mistä on kysymys. Heti saapumisen jälkeen Anne vierailee erityisessä koulussa, jossa tunne-elämän tasapaino on yhtä tärkeää kuin varsinainen oppiminen. Anders tapaa maan pääministerin sekä tanskalaisen Larsin, joka tuntee onnellisuutta vaalivan maan harvinaisen hyvin.

programme.title: Nimipäiväonnittelu: 31.10.
programme.desc: Onnea kaikille! Animaatiosarjassa touhuaa porkkanapäinen Touho-poika, joka loihtii milloin mitäkin muovailuvahasta. Lopussa onnitellaan nimipäiväsankareita.

programme.title: Pikku Kakkonen
programme.desc: Ohjelmaa perheen pienimmille.

programme.title: Late lammas (S)
programme.desc: Laten seikkailuissa tavataan taas Vuhku, Lampolan luupäät, Porsastelevat porsaat, Maajussi ja hänen uusi kissansa Katinkurpale.

programme.title: Karmiva hirviö (7)
programme.desc: Pikkuinen ja suloinen hirviö Lari ei usko omaan karmivuuteensa, vaan pukeutuu karmeaan hirviöpukuun ollakseen pelottava. Eräänä halloweenina Lari jää jälkeen muista hirviöistä, eikä ehdikään lähteä ajoissa taikaportaalin kautta kotiin. Ihmisten maailmaan jumiin jäänyt Lari löytää uuden ystävän, Nean, joka auttaa Laria uskomaan itseensä - ja lopulta pääsemään kotiin.

programme.title: Tipu Touhukas (7)
programme.desc: Tipu ihmettelee, kun Tirppa painaa nappuloita eikä mitään tapahdu. Vai tapahtuuko?

programme.title: Mysteerikuja (7)
programme.desc: Itse kuningatar pyytää Välkyltä apua erittäin salaiseen tehtävään. Kuningattaren salainen agentti C on juuri kadonnut mystisesti.

programme.title: Tiettömän taipaleen takana
programme.desc: Tuntuu mahdottomalta ajatukselta, että yksinäisellä saarella voisi elää ja asua vanhana ja sairaalloisena. Norjalaiset Borgny ja Roald Mathisen selviävät kuitenkin vielä toistaiseksi pienellä Husøyalla, vaikka heillä on ikää 82 ja 93 vuotta.

programme.title: Tiettömän taipaleen takana
programme.desc: Vaikka joidenkin mielestä Norjassa Skagerrakin rannikolla sijaitseva Merdøn saari on maailman kaunein saari, ympärivuotisesti siellä asuu vain yksi ihminen, Trond Helle. Saari on kuitenkin tärkeä myös muille kuin Trondille.

programme.title: Magnifica: Kutsumaton vieras (S)
programme.desc: Lyhytelokuva mökkiläisten ja hyytelösammaleläimen rinnakkaiselosta. Elokuva seuraa ihmisten ällistystä rantavedet vallanneen omituisen olennon edessä, sekä yrityksiä päästä siitä eroon. O: Ville Koskinen. T: Polygraf / Sisyfos Film Production (Suomi/Ruotsi 2024)

programme.title: Hiihdon Suomen cup: Sprintit (V)
programme.desc: Maastohiihdon Suomen Cup-kausi avataan Vuokatissa vapaan sprinttikisalla. Selostus Kimmo Porttila, asiantuntija Katri Lylynperä.

programme.title: Sportliv
programme.desc: Kun yskän ja keuhko-ongelmien syyksi paljastui imusolmukesyöpä, Mårten Boströmin elämä mullistui täysin. Sportliv-ohjelmassa sprinttisuunnistuksen maailmanmestari kertoo shokista, epävarmuudesta ja puolen vuoden solunsalpaajahoidoista. Mutta myös toivosta sekä siitä, kuinka tärkeää oli päästä luontoon liikkumaan, jopa sairaalajaksojen aikana.

programme.title: Erämaan armoilla
programme.desc: Lars Monsenin matkaseurana on koomikko Lisa Tønne. Kun Monsen näkee Lisan pop-up-teltan, hän tajuaa, että Lisa ei ole mikään erämaaseikkailija. Mutta Lisan matkavarusteista on kuitenkin hyötyä mukana kulkeville nelijalkaisille vaeltajille.

programme.title: Eränkävijät: Alpeilta Arktiselle
programme.desc: Italiassa metsästyskausi on alkanut, ja myös Norjassa suunnataan erälle. Aki ja Äijä valmistautuvat pitkään kaamosaikaan, ja Itävallassa rauhoitutaan lumisen metsän kauneuteen. Venäjän Karjalassa Viktor löytää susilauman.

programme.title: Felix And Klara (7)
programme.desc: Felix ja Klara lähtevät kiertoajelulle Felixin kuorokavereiden kanssa. Matkan aikana Klara juo liikaa ja Felix nolaa itsensä. Molempien on kannettava tekojensa seuraukset.

programme.title: Jokaisen miehen takana (12)
programme.desc: Cecilie on kutsunut koko henkilökunnan tiimipäivään idylliselle kartanolle, mutta harjoitus harjoitukselta tunnelma muuttuu yhä kireämmäksi.

programme.title: Minun metsäni
programme.desc: Moottoripyöräpoliisi Staffan Söderströmille metsä on paikka, jossa voi harjoitella ja ajaa kilpaa motocrossia. Metsä sinänsä ei Staffania kiinnosta, hän ei edes erota eri puulajeja toisistaan. Sitten hän perii isoja metsäalueita ja ryhtyy metsuriksi! Toimittaja Frida Frankenhaeuser puolestaan on kaupunkilainen, joka rakastaa vanhojen metsien monimuotoisuutta, ja avohakkuut itkettävät häntä. Hän kutsuu itseään metsähipiksi. Nyt Frida aikoo ostaa metsää suojellaakseen sitä.

programme.title: Lomittajat (7)
programme.desc: Syksy on saapunut, laidunkausi on lopuillaan. Akin elämänmuutos konkretisoituu, kun sukupolvenvaihdos on pian totta. Muutos lomittajasta tilalliseksi vaatii paljon. Anna-Maija käynnistelee vanhaa juoksuharrastustaan ja miettii kotitilansa tulevaisuutta. Anne S. keskittyy töissä vasikoiden vierihoitoon ja iloitsee kotona kattoremontin valmistumisesta. Anne A. laskee lampaita ja juhlii syntymäpäiviään. Myös Maijalla on aihetta juhlaan.

programme.title: Monissa häissä (S)
programme.desc: Trecyn ja Jeremian hääpäivä ei ala suunnitelmien mukaan: aikataulut venyvät ja tunnelma horjuu. Henok ja Barkot valmistautuvat häihin läheistensä kanssa. Gandharv ja Lavanya pääsevät vihdoin viettämään yhteistä aikaa kahdestaan.

programme.title: Sohvaperunat
programme.desc: Kovan viikon ilta vie sohvikset poliittisten puheenaiheiden äärelle ja Pirjon rumempi Suomi haastaa pohtimaan kauneusihanteita. Lomittajissa sukelletaan maatilan arkeen ja Pirunpelissä jännitetään, kuka saa valtakortin.

programme.title: Luottomies 3 (7)
programme.desc: Kausi 3, 3/8. Naapuruston ilmatilassa pörrää terroristi. Onneksi Juhis (Kari Ketonen) taitaa hybrisodan jalon taidon. Kyse on myös lasten tulevaisuudesta.

programme.title: Fokus (12)
programme.desc: Miinan paluu Fokukselle aiheuttaa kuohuntaa järjestössä. Tove keksii kyseenalaisen tavan kustantaa yksityisvalmennus. Miinan menneisyys uhkaa paljastua.

programme.title: Justimus esittää: Henki Vex (16)
programme.desc: Aatos, Risto ja Pasi joutuvat jälleen yhdistämään voimansa, kun salaperäinen kirottu video lähtee leviämään Heinäjärvellä. Mysteerin avain on kauan sitten kadonnut iskelmälaulaja, jonka kohtalon selvittääkseen Henkivex-kolmikon on kohdattava kauhuja ylösnousemuksesta uusperhearkeen.

programme.title: Toive-elokuva: Pahanhautoja (16)
programme.desc: Nuori Tinja-tyttö yrittää toteuttaa vaativan äitinsä unelman menestymällä telinevoimistelussa. Eräänä yönä Tinja löytää oudon linnunmunan ja hautoo sitä salassa huoneessaan, kunnes munasta kuoriutuu jotain, joka järkyttää heitä kaikkia.

programme.title: Toive-elokuva: Kuutamosonaatti (16)
programme.desc: Kuutamosonaatti on kauhuelokuva, jonka näyttämönä toimii syrjäinen kylä Suomessa. Kylässä asuvat Kyyrölän aikamiespojat Sulo ja Arvo jakomielitautisen äitinsä kanssa. Veljeksistä toinen on vähämielinen jättiläinen ja toinen vitsalla kiusattu psykopaatti. Aina täydenkuun aikaan poikien vaistot heräävät. Kylän laidalla on hiihtomaja, johon kaunis valokuvamalli Anni Stark saapuu lyhyelle hermolomalle.

programme.title: Queen of Fucking Everything (16)
programme.desc: Korkealuokkaisten asuntojen välittäjän Lindan aviomies on kadonnut ja jättänyt miljoonavelat Lindan maksettavaksi. Ulosotto vie viimeisetkin varat ja Linda yrittää pitää elämänsä kasassa hinnalla millä hyvänsä. Linda lainaa unohdetulta lapsuudenystävältään Markelta rahaa ja sotkeutuu keskelle likaisia bisneskuvioita.

programme.desc: Devastated by a friend's murder, Julisa holds a séance to communicate one last time - and unwittingly invites a dark spirit into her life. Julisa and her mother believe that she has reignited the evil that plagued her mother years ago.

programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, Bill and Tom transform the Lake Club into a rock 'n' roll nightclub. However, phantom music and inexplicable blasts of cold air make them believe that they are not alone.

programme.desc: Ginger moves her family into an old mansion in Wisconsin. She begins a meticulous restoration, but a supernatural presence drives her husband to the brink of homicidal madness.

programme.desc: When Bonnie and her family buy a 19th-century farmhouse in Connecticut, they sense that they are being watched. They contact a team of psychic investigators to find out what they are living with.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona, which becomes her future home. After she moves in, Romie begins to have nightmares and she sees a shadowy spirit pacing in her hallway.

programme.desc: Ron and Nancy are convinced that their new home is ideally suited to their budget. However, in the house, objects start to move by themselves and they later learn that their house is a way station between life and death.

programme.desc: When a mother and a teenager are evicted from a townhouse in Montreal, the young girl commits suicide.

programme.desc: On the banks of the Licking River, club owner Bobby Mackey has heard tales that the river draws murderers as well as Satanists to the area and that there have been times when the waters ran red with blood.

programme.desc: With their first child on the way, Deb and Tony move in Atchison, Kansas. But when their son is born, the child's toys seem to take on a life of their own and strange whispers torment Tony.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, an American family refuses to believe there are ghosts in their house until their daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest explains that their house has been designed to empower the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Brookfield, Connecticut, young David suffers from intense nightmares and is physically attacked by an invisible entity. Paranormal investigators make contact with a legion of demons inside the child's body.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: An enigmatic photo of her boyfriend's brother killed in Vietnam entrances Lisa. As her obsession grows, she realizes that the spirit of the dead soldier is taking control of their lives.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In a small house in Glen Burnie, Maryland, unseen intruders attack 10-year-old Billy Bean. Billy struggles to learn the secrets of the house and fight them in any way he can - to save his sanity.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Clara and her family move into a small home in rural Hinsdale, New York, they realize that the peace of life in the country is merely an illusion - and the threat of death is very real.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ed and Beth's ranch house seems like the perfect place to raise their toddler until they discover that they are not alone. A dark, heavy mist hangs over the house and grows larger day by day.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Following the breakup of his marriage, Steven LaChance begins to experience strange things inside his house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Selena and her 3-year-old son move into an old house in Michigan, a series of photographs show what she cannot see with the naked eye: an evil face in the attic.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Mike and his girlfriend Lisa move in their new house, Lisa's personality begins to change dramatically.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Randy recites an incantation from a book on witchcraft, hoping to make contact with spirits of the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in the same townhouse in the city of Galway, Irelan, for decades. But when a new baby arrives, he stirs up the psychic energy of a terrible crime committed many years ago.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When April James and her fiance Matt buy a historic home in Salt Lake City, Utah, they immediately begin extensive work to make it their own, unaware of a ghostly inhabitant that detests change.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit, phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced once-in-a-century floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, Waverley, the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, Waverley circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the Paddle Steamer Preservation Society in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like slow food: sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts And Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts And Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts And Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Natural da Ria Formosa is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the Ria Formosa was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey - Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The Jersey Royal, the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. The potato is our most important export commodity, she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a solution for our planet's refuse problem. Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an Eco seal for sustainable fishing for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: Mother Nature is the true artist.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' problem kids: they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Inside China's Q3 Economy
programme.desc: China's economy expanded 4.6% in the first three quarters, with exports and high-tech manufacturing continuing to provide support, while consumption and industrial output picked up in September. What do the latest numbers reveal about China's growth momentum and economic transformation? Can renewed momentum and an improved structure help sustain growth in the months ahead? Join BizTalk as leading economists and experts take a closer look at China's Q3 economic performance, unpack the key signals behind the headline numbers, and assess the outlook for growth.

programme.title: Adidas CEO: Competition with Chinese brands makes us better
programme.desc: German sportswear giant Adidas has been in China for decades, but it's no longer just selling a European playbook. Its In China, For China model puts designers, creatives and supply chains directly into the bustle of the world's second largest economy - where competition is fierce and Chinese sportswear brands are stronger than ever. Recently in Shanghai, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu caught up with Adidas global CEO Bjørn Gulden to find out more.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions'
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

programme.title: Live: Canton Fair's 'hidden champions' - small firms, global reach
programme.desc: They're not household names, but global supply chains depend on them. At the 140th Canton Fair, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, managing director of the Rothenberger Group and a longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors - from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs are the backbone of China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird's eye can see into the west...

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named Duck Poo Fragrance tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional yum cha breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling kueh rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2
programme.desc: Heilongjiang, China's northernmost province, is home to a veritable sea of trees, a forest forged by the Greater and Lesser Khingan Ranges. Beginning our Odyssey at its very northern extremity - a land of snowy Arctic snowscape and dazzling rime-frosts that's a paradise for winter-sports daredevils - we then head for Harbin and its spectacular ice festival in pursuit of some unique snowy adventures...

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named Duck Poo Fragrance tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional yum cha breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling kueh rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, Fun Guide to China. Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an Old Dad Tea restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach....

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down...
