programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya and everyone starts acting paranoid.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture which is more than it seems. The picture shows Chiana what will happen to her.

programme.title: Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn can tolerate the spores.

programme.title: Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: After the Gammak base is destroyed, Zhaan is on trial for murder. Chiana and Rygel act as her defense lawyers.

programme.title: Out Of Their Minds
programme.desc: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

programme.title: My Three Crichtons
programme.desc: Crichton is cloned into a version who is a de-evolved 'cave man' and another who has increased mental ability.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: Princess Katralla, cannot ascend unless she finds a mate genetically compatible to her poisoned DNA.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton faces 80 years as a statue. The Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into acid.

programme.title: Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.

programme.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton returns to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth? Is this some trick, if so who is behind it and why.

programme.title: The Locket
programme.desc: A time distortion traps Aeryn and John to live out the rest of their lives. On Moya it's only a few hours.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.

programme.title: A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group come aboard Moya and attempt to mind cleanse everyone using a drug.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 1, A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: Stark helps the crew with a plan to steal money from a depository to free D'Argo's son, Jothee, from slavery.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 2, With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew breaks into the depository to free Crichton with the help of Talyn's unexpected arrival.

programme.title: Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: The crew meets with a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns and remove Crichton's neural chip.

programme.title: Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, while Scorpius tries to avoid discovery. Zhaan makes a personal sacrifice.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: 3 wins to come out on top, who's it going to be? Rico Verhoeven, Levi Rigters, Tarik Osaro, Benjamin Adegbuyi, Sofian Laidouni, Uku Jurjendal, Bahram Rajabzadeh, and Nabil Khachab pair up and throw down for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix, an 8-man 1-night heavyweight tournament for the ages.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The eight-man one-night GLORY Light Heavyweight Grand Prix will crown the baddest light heavyweight striker on the planet. The eight participants are: GLORY champion, #C Tarik Khbabez (58-10-1, 28 KO), Morocco. Former champion, #1 Donegi Abena (27-10, 7 KO), Suriname. Former champion, #2 Sergej Maslobojev (38-6, 23 KO), Lithuania. Undefeated in GLORY, #3 Stefan Latescu (17-2, 8 KO), Romania. ‘Mister Cool’ #4 Ibrahim El Bouni (41-9-1, 22 KO), Morocco. The wild And unpredictable, #5 Bahram Rajabzadeh (67-2, 59 KO), Azerbaijan. Top French light heavyweight, #6 Pascal Toure (20-6, 7 KO), France. Veteran fighter, #7 Bogdan Stoica (58-14, 40 KO), Romania.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The main event will see two of the light heavyweight division’s most explosive young prospects clash as Romania’s Stefan Latescu (17-3, 8 KO) faces Turkey’s Cem Caceres (16-1, 13 KO). Belgium based Albanian Berjan Peposhi (29-4, 16 KO) will compete in the co-main event. The always exciting featherweight welcomes rising star Ayoub Bourass (14-1, 4 KO) in to make his GLORY debut. International Muay Thai superstar Youssef Boughanem (188-43-8, 120 KO) returns for his sophomore GLORY outing against tough Italian Angelo Volpe (38-5, 12 KO). Former middleweight title contender Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-10, 36 KO) takes on Antwerp’s own Jente Nnamadim (21-5, 11 KO), who comes in to make his GLORY debut in his hometown.

programme.desc: Johnny Rush, an Indian wars veteran, returns home to find his land seized by a cattle baron and his love engaged to the enemy. Determined to reclaim his home and confront betrayal, he fights back against overwhelming odds.

programme.title: The Girl from San Lorenzo

After breaking them out of jail, the real heroes have a chance to escape and clear their names by capturing the imposters. Will they succeed or be caught again?

programme.title: Apache Fury

programme.desc: Colonel Mackenzie, commander of the 4th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Clark near Brackettville in Kinney County in southwest Texas during the 1870s, receives secret orders from President Ulysses S. Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
programme.desc: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

programme.title: Silver Lode

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Boo! Did that scare you? If so, then you better steer clear of this super spooky Holiday Eatz Halloween episode with chef-host Kimberly Lallouz! But that would be too bad, because then you'd miss a menu featuring fun but grown-up Halloween eats like Jack O'Lantern Curry, served with Irish-inspired spiced Pumpkin Barmbrack bread. Next, you'd miss a ghostly surprise with her pan seared Black Cod buried in a pile of carrot-chip 'Autumn Leaves' and drizzled with mango sauce made with... ghost peppers! Her 'Fet Ghede' (Haitian Day of the Dead) inspired beef rib follows... with a rib bone connected to... melting tender beef braised in Haiti's signature Epis spice and crunched-up with yummy pumpkin seeds. For a sweet ending, it's a 'Bag of Candy'... or in this case, homemade profiterole stuffed with mascarpone and all of your favourite candies! See, that wasn't so scary, was it? Mwahahahaha!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Property renovation series. A flat in Edinburgh, a 1930s terraced house in Bromley in Kent and a five-bedroom house in Exeter in danger of falling down are sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A smart looking terrace with an expensive problem to fix in Pontygwaith in Wales, a large Victorian house in Okehampton in Devon and an old pub in Sittingbourne in Kent all go under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin meets a couple who plan to convert a large listed shop into their dream home in Shropshire, and a property developer working on a maisonette in South Wales. Lucy follows a five-year project to restore a 17th-century listed building in Kent

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin and Lucy go flat-tastic looking around buildings which developers hope will create around a dozen flats. The properties sold under the hammer are in Stoke in Staffordshire, Bexleyheath in Kent and Gunnislake in Cornwall.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A five-bedroom house in Plymouth, a two-bed Victorian cottage in Croydon and a former coach house in Cardiff are sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the developers to hear about their plans to make the most of their auction buys.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy catches up on a new build in Chatham in Kent, while Martin meets a developer working on a terraced house in Lincolnshire

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Dion looks round a complex auction lot of two houses and a piece of land in Silverdale near Newcastle-under-Lyme

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: An end terraced house in Silverdale, a mid terrace in Derby and a one bedroom flat in a London tower block are all sold under the hammer

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A trio of three bedroom semi-detached properties in Barnet, Madeley, and Bramcote, Nottinghamshire are all sold under the hammer

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A three-bed semi in Stoke-on-Trent, a ground-floor flat in Walthamstow and a terraced house in Aberdare in Wales being auctioned

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A 1930s semi with a sunny disposition in Chatham, a piece of land in Tylortown and a mid-terrace in Perry Barr all under the hammer

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A house that has been with the same family for more than 60 years in Carlton, house in East Ham and a former care home in Stoke on Trent

programme.title: Surrounded
programme.desc: Entinen sotilas Mo Washington matkaa länteen etsimään kultakaivosta. Väijytys pakottaa hänet vangitsemaan lainsuojattoman, johtaen taisteluun karussa erämaassa. Ohjaaja: Anthony Mandler. Pääosissa Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell ja Michael K. Williams.

programme.title: Salattu totuus
programme.desc: Tässä upeassa neo-noir-elokuvassa elokuvalegendat Robert De Niro ja Robert Duvall tekevät upeat roolisuoritukset sisaruksina, jotka ovat sekaantuneet järkyttävään murhatutkimukseen, jossa he joutuvat vastakkain. Mukana myös Charles Durning ja Burgess Meredith.

programme.title: You're Not You
programme.desc: Kaksinkertainen Oscar-voittaja Hillary Swank on menestynyt konserttipianisti Kate, jossa todetaan parantumaton sairaus ALS. Hänen perheensä järjestää hänelle parasta mahdollista hoitoa, mutta Kate itse antautuu täysin epäpätevän Becin hoiviin.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. Hänen vanhin poikansa Blake (Oscar-voittaja* Colin Firth) muuttaa Yorkshireen äitinsä luokse, kylään jossa hän syntyi. Kun Arthurin tila heikkenee, Blake puntaroi suhdettaan isäänsä.

programme.title: Manhattan
programme.desc: Tässä modernissa klassikossa Isaacilla (Woody Allen) on liian nuori tyttöystävä ja ex-vaimo, joka on laatimassa paljastustarinaa heidän elämästään. Mutta tavatessaan Maryn (Diane Keaton) alkaa hänen täyttymyksen etsintänsä rakkaalla Manhattanillaan.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelunkanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Stronger on inspiroiva tositarina Jeff Baumanista, tavallisesta 27-vuotiaasta miehestä, josta tuli toivon symboli vuoden 2013 Bostonin maratonin pommi-iskun jälkeen.

programme.title: Two Is Family
programme.desc: Samuel elelee huolettomasti Ranskan Rivieralla, kunnes kuvaan astuu yllättäen entinen ihastus, Kristin. Kristin ilmoittaa Samuelille, että tästä on tullut pienen tytön isä, ojentaa vauvan hänelle ja häipyy!

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Rikkailla asuinalueilla turvatoimia osataan arvostaa. Niin myös Millerin perheen kodissa.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Vaughn tarvitsee rahaa sairaan tyttärensä hoitokuluihin. Yhdessä kollegansa Coxin kanssa Vaughn yrittää ryöstää rahat häikäilemättömältä kasino-omistajalta, The Popelta.

programme.title: Kerttu ja hannu
programme.desc: Kertun ja Hannun tarina sijoittuu hamaan menneisyyteen, kaukaiseen maalaismaisemaan. Ruuasta ja työstä on pulaa, ja niiden perässä nuori Kerttu (Sophia Lillis) johdattaa veljensä metsään, jossa turvan ja helpotuksen sijaan nuoret kohtaavatkin pahuuden keskittymän.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell on päättänyt mennä naimisiin, mutta perinteisen ja tiukkapipoisen perheen yllätykseksi Jennyn kihlattu onkin nainen. Järkyttynyt Farrellin perhe yrittää totutella ajatukseen uudesta miniästä.

programme.title: 7 Days In Entebbe
programme.desc: Todellisten tapahtumien inspiroima 7 Days in Entebbe kertoo lentokoneen kaappauksesta Air Francen lennolla 139 Tel Avivista Pariisiin vuonna 1976 ja sitä seuranneesta uskaliaasta pelastusoperaatiosta.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Zane, tähtitieteilijä, löytää avaruusolentoja, mutta avaruusolennoilla on tappava salaisuus ja he tekevät kaikkensa estääkseen Zanea saamasta sitä selville.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton on nuori ja komea mutta rahaton tennisvalmentaja, joka sotkeutuu rikkaan perheen kuvioihin ryhdyttyään perheen tyttären valmentajaksi. Rakkaussuhteet kahden eri naisen kanssa pakottavat hänet julmaan rikokseen. Intohimoa, kiusauksia ja mielettömyyttä yläluokan Lontoossa.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: A Cry In The Dark
programme.desc: Tässä mukaansatempaavassa draamassa eletään vuotta 1980, ja Chamberlainin perhe suuntaa telttaretkelle Australian suosituimman turistinähtävyyden, Ayers Rockin, läheisyyteen erämaahan – matka, joka muuttaa heidän elämänsä ikuisesti. Pääosissa Meryl Streep ja Sam Neill!

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Journalisti John Klein ja hänen vaimonsa Mary joutuvat kohtalokkaaseen onnettomuuteen. Vaimon kuoleman jälkeen Johnin pakkomielteeksi muodostuvat Maryn sairaalassa tekemät luonnokset, jotka kuvaavat tummaa, siivekästä hahmoa.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Perustuu tositarinaan neljästä ulkopuolisesta, jotka näkivät sen, minkä isot pankit, media ja valtionhallinto kielsivät: maailmantalouden romahtamisen. Rohkea sijoittaminen johtaa heidät pankkialan pimeälle puolelle, jossa kaikki on kyseenalaistettava.

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: Varakkaan ja mahtavan perheen patriarkka menehtyy äkillisesti jättäen vaimolleen ja tyttärelleen järkyttävän, salaisen perinnön, joka uhkaa turmella ja tuhota heidän elämänsä.

programme.title: A Dangerous Method
programme.desc: Todellisiin tapahtumiin perustuva elokuva psykoanalyysin synnystä kertoo psykiatri Carl Jungin, hänen mentorinsa Sigmund Freudin ja kauniin mutta mieleltään järkkyneen Sabina Spielreinin myrskyisästä suhteesta.

programme.title: Hostiles
programme.desc: Lännenelokuva kertoo tarinan verivihollisista, jotka joutuvat pakosta sietämään toisiaan.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: The Setup
programme.desc: Wrongly suspended from the force for beating a suspect, Hunter pursues the gangster who had him discredited.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 1

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 2

programme.title: The Return Of Typhoon Thompson

programme.title: Saturday Night Special
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate mysterious calls to a reporter about a series of murders.

programme.title: Overnight Sensation
programme.desc: Hunter attempts to apprehend a vicious robbery suspect while he clashes with a vindictive reporter.

programme.title: Change Partners And Dance
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall must work individually after they are separated as partners by their new precinct leader.

programme.title: Crime Of Passion
programme.desc: While investigating a homicide, McCall falls in love with the prime suspect - the victim's husband.

programme.title: The Castro Connection
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall attempt to break a cocaine syndicate apparently being run by one of Hunter's ex-partners.

programme.title: High Noon In L.A.
programme.desc: Hunter receives a death threat from a quick-tempered foreign official determined to avenge his brother's death

programme.title: From San Francisco With Love
programme.desc: A police detective aids in solving a series of murders connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.

programme.title: True Confessions
programme.desc: The search for a vengeful woman suspected of murdering two men involved in her sister's cocaine-related death.

programme.title: Love, Hate And Sporty James
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall's kidnapping-homicide investigation is thwarted by a rich industrialist.

programme.title: The Cradle Will Rock
programme.desc: McCall masquerades as a nightclub singer to investigate the disappearance of a rock music star.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: The malicious leader of paramilitary neo-Nazis take Hunter and McCall captive while planning their next attack

programme.title: Down And Under
programme.desc: Hunter goes to Australia to help solve a murder involving a former girlfriend who's been missing for 3 years.

programme.title: Straight To The Heart
programme.desc: Hunter falls in love with a beautiful professional killer who's connected to an arson case he's investigating.

programme.title: Requiem For Sergeant McCall
programme.desc: McCall is charged with murder when the prime suspect in her dead detective husband's case is found dead.

programme.title: Double Exposure
programme.desc: Sergeant McCall poses as a fashion model to expose a burglary ring preying on wealthy businessmen.

programme.title: The Girl Next Door

programme.title: Any Second Now

programme.title: A Child Is Born
programme.desc: A musician helps search for the assailant of a pregnant woman being kept alive until she can give birth.

programme.title: Crossfire
programme.desc: McCall fears that Hunter's temper will outweigh his judgement when his former girlfriend is murdered.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit, Part 1
programme.desc: McCall is shot and paralyzed after learning about a prostitution ring operating in a fleet of motor homes.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit, Part 2
programme.desc: As doctors prepare to operate on McCall, Hunter races to find whoever is killing potential witnesses.

programme.title: Shades
programme.desc: When Hunter disappears during an investigation, McCall and her new partner must find him before he's killed.

programme.title: Not Just Another John Doe
programme.desc: A murder, but the victim seemingly never existed, and the killing appears to be professionally done.

programme.title: Playing God
programme.desc: After the murder of a crime boss, Hunter and McCall face an ethical dilemma: arrest the killer or let him go.

programme.title: Flashpoint

programme.title: Night On Bald Mountain

programme.title: City Of Passion, Part 1

programme.title: City Of Passion, Part 2

programme.title: City Of Passion, Part 3

programme.title: Turning Point

programme.title: Allegra

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: When Hunter investigates a drug ring, his ex-partner becomes a suspect in the murder of the dealers.

programme.title: The Black Dahlia

programme.title: The Bogota Million

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: The wife of a dead businessman becomes the prime suspect when it's discovered she was removed from his will.

programme.title: The Fourth Man
programme.desc: Hunter investigates the missing money from an old bust that implicates the police in criminal activity.

programme.title: Murder He Wrote
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate the death of a multi-millionaire, whose four heirs become prime suspects.

programme.title: Silver Bullet
programme.desc: The only clue in a series of murders leads Hunter and McCall to suspect a colleague as the killer.

programme.title: Heir Of Neglect

programme.title: The Baby Game
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall find the murdered body of a call girl, and a toddler left unharmed in front of her tv set.

programme.desc: Jonathan bikes through Montenegro, explores hidden bunkers and Tito’s estate, visits Kotor Bay, tries local food, and joins a mountain rescue patrol.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - Vietnam
programme.desc: Jonathan rides from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh, finding hidden bunkers, rebel stories, rare martial arts, ancient ruins, and everyday heroes.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - Bali
programme.desc: Jonathan forages Bali’s jungle, explores temples, visits Trunyan’s burial village, uncovers trash issues, and discovers hidden local wonders.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - Their Adventure Begins
programme.desc: Two adrenaline junkies that love nothing more than off road adventure motor biking. And they’re off on their most epic journey ever, to Argentina.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - Broken Bike
programme.desc: Rob and Dave are pushed to their limits. Fighting through the rough ride across the scorching sand dunes littered with shrubbery Rob is unable to continue.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - Separate Riders
programme.desc: Rob and Dave’s patience are pushed to the limits as the whole trip hangs in the balance of Rob’s broken clutch. Will they have to buy a new bike?

programme.title: Running the World S1 - Copenhagen
programme.desc: Max And Benj Cave travel to Copenhagen to meet up with a local free runner and undertake an epic run of Tivoli Gardens.

programme.title: Running the World S1 - London
programme.desc: Max And Benj Cave travel to London where they are challenged to create a run in the Olympic Park.

programme.title: Running the World S1 - Paris
programme.desc: Max And Benj Cave travel to France where they are challenged to create a run in historic Lisses.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - Hawkes Bay
programme.desc: Padre takes Piri to the river mouth fishing for kahawai. Plus we follow the dugs in search of wild pigs.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - Mahia
programme.desc: Piri heads to Mahia to hit the ocean in search for kingfish with his guide, Justice. Later he goes diving for sea urchins and crayfish.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - Inspired Design
programme.desc: Architects get their inspiration for their designs from literally everywhere. Johanna and Pete discover some truly unorthodox architecture that has been inspired from surprising places.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - Urban Castles
programme.desc: Take a look at contemporary urban architecture through 6 very different styles. Each luxurious home has been built within suburban neighbourhoods but that’s where the similarity ends.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - Sweetness in the Family
programme.desc: Cakes, maple syrup and taro puree tell a story of inheritance, memory and innovation in different parts of the world. They demonstrate how food can become a symbol of cultural identity and family heritage.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Tärkeä jaden ostaja ei ole vaikuttunut Pit 3:n linssistä, joten Claudia joutuu tekemään vaikean päätöksen, joka tuottaa pettymyksen miehistölle.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Wolverinen leirin pakkaaminen muuttuu painajaiseksi, kun kuumuus, sairaudet ja metsäpalo iskevät miehistön päälle.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Raaka vaellus uudelle kaivospaikalle erottaa perheenjäsenet toisistaan ja Josh on murtumaisillaan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Claudia haluaa kovasti aloittaa uuden kaivospaikan rakentamisen, mutta edistystä jarruttaa joukko epäonnisia tapahtumia heidän vanhalla kaivosleirillään Wolverinessa.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Leirin pienet ylellisyydet piristävät tyytymätöntä miehistöä, ja yllättävät vierailijat herättävät Claudian toiveet tulevaisuudestaan 2 Milessa.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Gary ja Josh eivät palaa rutiininomaiselta polttoaineenhakumatkaltaan, ja kairasydämet herättävät epäilyksiä 2 Milen jadelinssien laadusta.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Miehistö tekee lopulta suuren löydön, mutta talven saapuessa Claudia on huolissaan siitä, että suuri löytö on ehkä tullut liian myöhään.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Claudia haluaa epätoivoisesti aloittaa kaivostoiminnan, mutta raa'at tieolosuhteet saavat hänet epäilemään, pääseekö miehistö edes alueelle.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Guy ja Gary kilpailevat korjatakseen huonokuntoista tietä, ja Claudia toivoo, että uusi miehistön jäsen olisi se onnenpotti, jota hän kipeästi tarvitsee.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Robinin yllättävä ostosreissu stressaa Claudiaa, kun hänen virheostoksensa viivästyttävät kaivoskauden avausta.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Claudia yrittää pitää rauhan yllä, kun Robin ja hänen isänsä ottavat yhteen, kun taas miehistö kamppailee korjatakseen yhden ongelman toisensa jälkeen kaivosautossaan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Gary ja Josh turhautuvat koneiden jatkuviin vikoihin, ja Claudia tekee järkyttävän ilmoituksen, joka suistaa Robinin suunnitelmat raiteiltaan ja aiheuttaa ristiriitoja pariskunnan välille.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Jännitteet Robinin, Joshin ja Steven välillä nousevat pintaan, kun he riitelevät kaivamisen tavasta, ja kun Claudia astuu kuvioihin, asiat muuttuvat suorastaan räjähdysalttiiksi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Autovikojen vaivaamat Robin ja hänen miehistönsä yrittävät saada polttoaineahakumatkan tehtyä ennen kuin polttoaine loppuu kesken.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Robin riitelee Claudian ja Joshin kanssa kaivokselta tulevan jaden laadusta, ja Larryn yritys siirtää kasarmi leiriin menee pieleen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | FI
programme.desc: Huonot jarrut, hermot kireällä ja epätasainen tie saavat Claudian epäilemään, pystyykö hänen miehistönsä raahaamaan valtavan kasarminsa leiriin ehjänä.

programme.desc: Dovervillen lapset kilpailevat aikaa ja mahdollisuuksia vastaan- pelastaakseen koiraorpokodin häikäilemättömältä pohatalta.

programme.title: Lähetys joulua
programme.desc: Kun hänen lähetyskumppaninsa päättää lähteä Amerikan suosikkiaamuohjelmasta, Veronika Daniels ilmoittaa valitsevansa uuden juontajakansa kourallisen ehdokkaiden joukosta, joihin kuuluu paikallinen New Yorkin uutislähettäjä Charlie Fisher.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: Pup Star -perhe on kasvanut! Uusien pentujen, Cindyn, Rosien, Charlien ja Brodyn tulee oppia, mitä joulu oikeasti tarkoittaa. Kun Pup Starin pahikset juonivat pilaavansa joulun, pennut päätyvät pohjoisnavalle pelastamaan joulupukin ja jouluhengen...

programme.title: Joulumaa
programme.desc: Joulumaa on nähnyt parempiakin päiviä Glindan menehdyttyä, ja Julesin täytyy tehdä valtavia päätöksiä.

programme.title: Joulu tilauksesta
programme.desc: Gretchen saa joulun tapahtua missä ja milloin tahansa.

programme.title: Jouluhäät
programme.desc: Haley Foster pakeni lapsuutensa pikkukaupungista Pineridgestä ja siirtyi suurkaupunkilaiselämään losangelesilaisena hääjärjestelijänä rva Reynoldsin omistamassa eliittiluokan yrityksessä.

programme.title: Maanviljelijä ja Belle Pelastavat Joulumaan
programme.desc: Kipinät lentävät kuuluisan mallin ja maanviljelijän välillä- kun tämä vierailee lapsuudenkodissaan. Kaupunki on vaarassa menettää rakkaan Joulumaan festivaalinsa- mutta rakkaus, perhe ja usko voivat tehdä ihmeitä.

programme.title: Tonttumies

programme.title: Lähetys joulua
programme.desc: Kun hänen lähetyskumppaninsa päättää lähteä Amerikan suosikkiaamuohjelmasta, Veronika Daniels ilmoittaa valitsevansa uuden juontajakansa kourallisen ehdokkaiden joukosta, joihin kuuluu paikallinen New Yorkin uutislähettäjä Charlie Fisher.

programme.title: Avain Jouluun
programme.desc: Kun tyytymätön tonttu valtaa pohjoisnavan, hän kääntää ajan taaksepäin, ja joulupukki alkaa nuortua nopeasti! Uskollisen tontun, pikkutytön, jolla on taika-avain- ja teini-ikäisen joulupukin on pelastettava joulun tulevaisuus.

programme.title: Santa Who?
programme.desc: Oikea joulupukki putoaa reestä ja menettää muistinsa. Hän törmää pian tympääntyneeseen TV-toimittajaan, joka on hänen ainoa toivonsa palauttaa muisti ajoissa, että joulu voidaan pelastaa.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming To Christmas Dinner?
programme.desc: Aktiivinen, liberaali ja edistyksellinen oikeustieteen opiskelija Maya tuo uuden poikaystävänsä kotiin jouluksi - kertomatta perheelleen, että hän on valkoinen. Arvaa, kuka tulee joulupäivälliselle?

programme.title: Tonttutyttö Pelastaa Joulun
programme.desc: Kun New Yorkin mafia sieppaa joulupukin juuri ennen joulua- Tonttutyttö, aivan tavallinen tonttu, tulee apuun. Hän lyöttäytyy yhteen ystävänsä Säihkyn kanssa- pysäyttääkseen pahikset, löytääkseen joulupukin ja pelastaakseen joulun.

programme.title: Joulun alla
programme.desc: CHRISTMAS UNDER WRAPS, esittelee Candace Cameron Buren tohtori Lauren Brunellin roolissa, joka hyväksyy työpaikan Alaskassa menetettyään sekä poikaystävänsä että arvostetun leikkausapurahansa, mutta saa tietää, että kyseessä on pieni sairaala pikkukaupungissa.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: Pup Star -perhe on kasvanut! Uusien pentujen, Cindyn, Rosien, Charlien ja Brodyn tulee oppia, mitä joulu oikeasti tarkoittaa. Kun Pup Starin pahikset juonivat pilaavansa joulun, pennut päätyvät pohjoisnavalle pelastamaan joulupukin ja jouluhengen...

programme.title: A Christmas in Royal Fashion
programme.desc: Kansainvälisen PR-yrityksen kaunis ja lahjakas assistentti Kristin Cooper saa vastuulleen vaatealalla työskentelevän liikemies Carsonin vuotuisen joulun muotinäytöksen ja huutokaupan järjestämisen.

programme.title: Avain Jouluun
programme.desc: Kun tyytymätön tonttu valtaa pohjoisnavan, hän kääntää ajan taaksepäin, ja joulupukki alkaa nuortua nopeasti! Uskollisen tontun, pikkutytön, jolla on taika-avain- ja teini-ikäisen joulupukin on pelastettava joulun tulevaisuus.

programme.title: Joulukuppikakkuja
programme.desc: Kun perheen leipomo joutuu ehkä sulkemaan ovensa juuri ennen joulua - siskokset Kimin ja Ginan on lyöttäydyttävä yhteen - voittaakseen leivontakilpailun, pelastaakseen perheyrityksen - ja ehkä jopa löytääkseen isomman palkinnon kuin toivoivat.

programme.title: Joulukievari
programme.desc: Kun liikenainen Jennifer kuulee vanhempiensa lähtevän matkoille jouluksi ilman häntä, hän päättää jättää San Franciscon humun taakseen ja lähteä Alaskaan tutustumaan isoäidiltään perinnöksi saamaansa kievarrin, joka on tarkoitus kunnostaa ja myydä.

programme.title: Joulukuponki
programme.desc: Luistelumestari alkaa opettaa luistelutunteja, mutta kun hänen entinen lukiorakkaansa (ja nyt kuuluisa jääkiekkoilija) tuo veljentyttärensä tunneille, joulu on täynnä toista mahdollisuutta rakkauteen.

programme.title: Perheellä on Väliä Joulu
programme.desc: Joulu on kaikkea muuta kuin tavallinen, kun kolme sisarusta uudesta uusperheestä - eivät ole samaa mieltä. Taikuuden avulla he vaihtavat kehoja eivätkä voi muuttua takaisin - ennen kuin oppivat viettämään joulun rakastavana perheenä.

programme.title: Nothing Like the Holidays
programme.desc: Tässä lämminhenkisessä joulukomediassa Rodriguezin perheen kauempana asuvat jäsenet kokoontuvat vanhempiensa kotiin kenties viimeistä kertaa viettämään joulua yhdessä.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: Menestysmysteerikirjailija Mary Higgins Clarkin romaaniin perustuva elokuva nähdään jouluna salapoliisitarinana. Naisetsivä lyöttäytyy yksiin amatöörietsivän kanssa löytääkseen kadonneen isänsä.

programme.title: Hemmetin Joulu
programme.desc: Telepaattisia kykyjä omaava koira pakenee sulkutilasta- ja juoksee suoraan kahden nuoren veljen rakastavaan syliin. Washingtonin johto ei luovu salaisesta aseestaan helpolla.

programme.title: Joulu tilauksesta
programme.desc: Gretchen saa joulun tapahtua missä ja milloin tahansa.

programme.title: Madness in the Method
programme.desc: Jason Mewes ei halua olla vain Jay and Silent Bobin Jay. Hän ottaa avukseen elokuvantekijä Kevin Smithin jäljittääkseen kirjan, joka voisi tehdä hänestä vakavan ja kunnioitetun näyttelijän. Sitä hän ei kuitenkaan tajua ottaa huomioon...

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Kun lähetti toimittaa vahingossa kätkettyjä kokaiinitiiliä sisältävän paketin väärään osoitteeseen, hän käynnistää tapahtumasarjan...

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Tarina keskittyy neljään ei-niin-nuoreen orpoon: yhden heistä on kasvattanut Louvren kuraattori; toinen on pakolainen meksikolaisesta vapaapainista; kolmas äskettäinen hänen lentokoneessaan olleiden käärmeiden uhri; ja neljäs normaali asukas mutantti X -yhteisöstä.

programme.title: Joe - jokapaikan höylä
programme.desc: Kun lempeäluonteinen nynny, Joe, haastaa toimiston kiusaajan tappeluun, hän lakkaakin olemasta muiden silmissä mitättömyys.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: PT-valmentajat (Cobie Smulders ja Guy Pearce) saavat tässä fiksussa ja hauskassa rakkautta ja ruumiinkuntoa käsittelevässä komediassa tehtäväkseen saada uusrikas ja hyvin motivoitumaton asiakas (Kevin Corrigan) kuntoon.

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva komedia mallikansalaisesta Steven Russellista, jonka radikaalilla elämänmuutoksella on hintansa. Patologisen valehtelijan munaukset vievät miehen suoraan kaapista häkkiin, kun hän jää luksuselämänsä rahoittamiseen kehitetyistä superhuijauksista kiinni rysän päältä.

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat: Reissussa
programme.desc: Lähde tien päälle suosikkikarvapallojesi kanssa! Jengi ryntää hurjalle road tripille kohti Miamia, mutta suunta kääntyykin hupaisiin musiikintäyteisiin seikkailuihin johtavalle kiertotielle.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: Viikko Hollywood-tuottajan Benin elämässä. Ben neuvottelee studiojohtajan kanssa, jotta hänen uusin elokuvansa saisi ensi-iltansa Cannesissa kahden viikon kuluttua. Hän on hermostunut ohjaaja, jonka on tehtävä editointi elokuvaan.

programme.title: Peace, Love And Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Komedia menestyksekkäästä newyorkilaisesta asianajajasta (Catherine Keener), joka tuo mukanaan kaksi vilkasta teini-ikäistä lastaan hippiäitinsä (Jane Fonda) luo maalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: Sinkkuna Suhteessa (That Awkward Moment)
programme.desc: Mikä voisi olla parempaa kuin olla sinkkuna New Yorkissa?

programme.title: Lowlife
programme.desc: Kun helppo elinvarkauskeikka menee pieleen, kohtalon oikku yhdistää kolme yhteiskunnan unohtamaa hylkiötä: Monstruon, meksikolaisen painijan, joka toimii rikospomon turvamiehenä.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Ben elää turvallisen tavallista keski-ikäisen elämää, johon kuuluu vaimo, talo ja haave omasta lapsesta. Eräänä päivänä oven taakse ilmestyy Andrew, vanha kaveri opiskeluajoilta, jonka taiteilijaelämä on kulkenut aivan toista rataa.

programme.title: Nurse Betty
programme.desc: Betty katsoo uskollisesti lempisaippuasarjaansa “Syy rakastaa. Törmättyään kahteen ammattitappajaan katsoessaan yhtä sarjan jaksoa Betty muuttuu “Nurse Bettyksi ja lähtee etsimään sydämensä valittua, tohtori David Ravellia.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Rakkaustarina feminiinisyydestä, maskuliinisuudesta ja 68 000 dollarin varkaudesta. Chip on simppeli kaveri ja upea tyttöystävä nimeltä Liza. Liza tosin hankkii heidän elantonsa namusedältään, mutta toisaalta jokaisessa parisuhteessa on omat erikoisuutensa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Karannutta vankia jahtaava agentti Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) lähtee suorittamaan peitetehtävää ja pukeutuu määräileväksi ja isokokoiseksi mummoksi, joka mottaa yhtä kovaa kuin komentaakin.

programme.title: The Wedding Guest
programme.desc: Sarja huvittavia ja onnettomia kohtauksia vain vahvistaa, että hän on rakastuneempi kuin koskaan.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Hamekyttä - Pojasta Polvi Paranee
programme.desc: Todistettuaan murhan FBI-agentti Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) ja hänen poikapuolensa (Brandon T. Jackson) joutuvat vetämään valeasut niskaansa ja ryhtymään tutkimuksiin...

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Keskilännessä 2000-luvun alussa varttuva 16-vuotias Alice on aina ollut hyvä katolilainen, mutta kun viaton nettikeskustelu muuttuu rohkeaksi, hän löytää masturboinnin ja on syyllisyyden riivaama.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: Danielin ja Robertin isän kuolema saattaa toraisan perheen yhteen suremaan vainajaa. Kun hautajaisiin ilmestyvä mies uhkaa paljastaa vainajan järkyttävän salaisuuden ellei saa rahaa, on veljesten keksittävä jotain päästäkseen kiristäjästä eroon.

programme.title: Joe - jokapaikan höylä
programme.desc: Kun lempeäluonteinen nynny, Joe, haastaa toimiston kiusaajan tappeluun, hän lakkaakin olemasta muiden silmissä mitättömyys.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren on rahapulassa ja Jimmy haluaa tehdä paluun tennismaailman huipulle. Siispä he päättävät lyöttäytyä yhteen, perustaa uudelleen nuoruutensa nelinpeliparin ja pyrkiä Grand Slam -turnaukseen karsintojen kautta.

programme.title: Blue Iguana
programme.desc: Kaksi entistä vankia on ehdonalaisessa vapaudessa ja tekee umpikujaan johtavia töitä newyorkilaisessa ruokalassa, kunnes heihin ottaa yhteyttä nörtti englantilainen asianajaja ja värvää heidät juoneen, jonka tarkoituksena on varastaa erittäin arvokas timantti.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Tervetuloa Westburgin lukioon jossa halitsee kolme kauneuskuningatarta, Heather C, Heather M ja Heather D. Heillä on valta, ulkonäkö ja rahat tehdäkseen mitä he haluavat.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Päällepäin ympäristökonsultti Adamilla, yksityisyrittäjä Mikellä ja ensiapulääkäri Neilillä ei ole mitään yhteistä, mutta he kaikki ovat mukana 12 askeleen ohjelmassa kohti vapautta riippuvuuksistaan.

programme.title: Amateur Night
programme.desc: Jason Biggs esittää Guyta, palkittua, vasta valmistunutta arkkitehtia. Nyt hän on kuitenkin työtön, tuleva isä, joka etsii epätoivoisesti töitä. Vaimonsa vaatimuksesta Guy vastaa netti-ilmoitukseen, jossa etsitään ”kuljettajaa”.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: Brother battles brother in this gritty tale of feuding ranchers in the old west. This story of the Texas panhandle stars such familiar faces as Robert Preston, Chill Wills, and Jack Elam, and was a rare film for its time in that it was filmed almost entirely in Texas with no studio interiors. If for no other reason, watch this one for Prestons performance. If you only know him from The Music Man or Victor Victoria, youre sure to be surprised here! (also, look for John Drew Barrymore as Jef Cloud. He was part of the famous Barrymore family, and father of Drew Barrymore.) Jim Strake: Frank Cordell. The Whip: Dave Kashner. Directed by George Templeton

programme.title: American Empire
programme.desc: This epic of America's westward march stars Leo Carrillo and Preston Foster in a tale of men building a cattle empire, only to battle rustlers, the weather, and each other! The romantic adventure from director William C. McGann (In Old California, Alcatraz Island) features a strong leading performance by Oscar nominated RKO star Richard Dix (Cimarron, The Ghost Ship) plus cinematography by six-time Oscar nominee Russell Harlan (To Kill a Mockingbird, Rio Bravo).

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: There's plenty of drama in this tale of lost gold mines, gallant stallions, and fuzzy bears. Starring Ken Curtis, Robert Lowery, and Chief Thundercloud, this charming little film is highlighted by Karl Struss' stunning photography

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Mason of the Mounted
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie Mason is sent south of the border to look for a horse thief with only a watch chain for evidence. He befriends young Andy and when Calhoun hits Andy, Mason and Calhoun fight. In the scuffle Calhoun's watch with the missing chain is dislodged. Mason then sets out to bring in Calhoun and his gang.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid, along with Pancho, try to help an unhappy bride.

programme.title: Crashing Thru
programme.desc: Down the danger trail sweeps a crimson fury... as Renfrew rides again! In this action-packed adventure, Sgt. Renfrew must face off against a group of criminals involved in a gold robbery. With his partner, Constable Kelly, wounded in a gunfight, Renfrew must stop the thieves on his own. Directed by Elmer Clifton; starring James Newill and Warren Hull, this is one adventure you won't want to miss!

programme.title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Sunset Carson is trying to raise money for a new school and his partner Sam Webster is out to stop him. When Carson plans a benefit prize-fight, Webster plans to make off with the proceeds. Direted by Oliver Drake; starring Sunset Carson, Al Terry, Pat Starling, Ron Ormond, Joe Hiser.

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together!

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.desc: From Malta to Greece, Mediterranean arts flourish. Valletta Baroque Festival, Malta International Arts Festival, and Birgu by Candlelight light up the island with music and heritage. France’s Art Paris and International Garden Festival, Spain’s Revela’t Festival and La Leyenda de Tartessos, Portugal’s Umbrella Sky Project and Walk And Talk Biennale, Turkey’s Istanbul Theatre Festival and Biennial, and Greece’s Athens And Epidaurus Festival highlight the Med’s rich artistic tapestry.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: La Firenze dei Medici
programme.desc: Explore the profound influence of the Medici family on the history of Florence, highlighting their rule from the 15th to the 16th century. The focus is on Lorenzo Il Magnifico, the era's most renowned figure. Through his life, we delve into iconic works linked to the Medici, including the masterpiece of architecture, the Dome of Santa Maria del Fiore, designed by Filippo Brunelleschi. The episode also features Florence’s own Sergio Staino, a celebrated designer and cartoonist, offering a unique perspective on the city’s rich cultural legacy.

programme.title: Paestum e Velia colonie greche d' Occidente
programme.desc: A journey from Greece to Italy during the archaic era involved diverse human groups settling in Southern Italy, which led to the establishment of Magna Grecia. Discover the archaeological sites of Poseidonia, Paestum, and Elea, Velia, where recent excavations have uncovered ancient temples and artefacts, revealing the region's rich history of cultural exchange and maritime conflicts.

programme.title: Baby On Board
programme.desc: A couple go through all kinds of emotional highs and lows as they expect a new addition to the family.

programme.title: A Mother's Heart
programme.desc: A man's love for his daughter is tested as another woman in his life comes in contest to that love.

programme.title: Getting A Yes
programme.desc: A loving daughter struggles to get the approval of her father for a suitor as he thinks no man is good enough for her.

programme.title: Indecent Affair
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. When a woman's controlling husband convinces her to pose as his cousin at a work event so his philandering boss can seduce her, the consequences are not only dire, but they also impose on everyone a journey of self discovery.

programme.title: The Drive
programme.desc: Becky and Chude are excited for their growing family, not realising just how much their unsavoury lifestyle will impact them.

programme.title: A Touch Of Fate
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Gerald, on the verge of marrying his boss's daughter and inheriting a car dealership, commits a hit-and-run after his bachelor party. When guilt drives him to inquire about the victim anonymously, he discovers he is being watched, leading to a complex web of secrets, guilt, and love.

programme.title: The Couple
programme.desc: A happily married couple face some challenges when the husband loses his job and a jealous friend makes it her mission to destroy their lives.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Cynthia is a single mother, haunted by bad dreams which she believes prevents her from finding love. She seeks help from a prophetess on the advise of her friends but soon finds out that she has been deceived.

programme.title: We Tha Boyz
programme.desc: Four jolly teenagers decide to help their friend, Tokunbo, in his plans to get the love of Chioma, however, a rival gang is also vying for her attention. Tokunbo’s parents go out of town and they decide to throw the ultimate house party to impress her. As simple as the plan seems, in reality however, they get in several problems in order to pull it off and end up almost ruining the house.

programme.title: The Hangout S6 Ep8
programme.desc: The Hangout returns for its sixth season with a group of opinionated, social media-savvy millennials who debate controversial topics on love, sex, friendship, and more.

programme.title: Blast From The Past
programme.desc: A long-lost father reappears as a boyfriend. Confused, heartbroken, and desperate for answers, Emily must confront the mystery surrounding her father’s disappearance and his unexpected re-emergence.

programme.title: Private Place
programme.desc: Two couples, faced with trouble in their respective marriages, take drastic action to get back on track.

programme.title: Dying Of Love
programme.desc: When his marriage proposal is rejected due to his current finanacial position, Tunde struggles to bounce back and trust his partner, leaving the door open for other temptation to get in.

programme.title: The Church Boy
programme.desc: Ify and Andy's near-perfect relationship is threatened by the beautiful Leah. How far will this relationship stand the test of time?

programme.title: Rhythm And Love
programme.desc: Tensions between two tenants, a budding musician and a social media influencer, continues to rise as they try to find a way to co-exist in each other's space.

programme.title: The Newly Married
programme.desc: A young couple get married very quickly after they meet, but they soon find out that they should have taken more time to get to know each other before marriage as their differences causes them to constantly fight.

programme.title: Undoing Perfect
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Jude, Theresa and their beautiful daughter Uju seem like the perfect family, but Theresa has a dark secret which she does everything to protect. Everything changes when Uju falls ill and requires immediate blood transfusion. Jude gets the shock of his life as he realizes he is not Uju’s father. Undoing perfect is a contemporary story of love, trust, betrayal and hurt, a sincere story of love and marriage.

programme.title: Another Chance To Love
programme.desc: In a home where love is tested by pride, a devoted wife demands fairness from her husband, insisting that since she works tirelessly to support the family, he must join her in the daily chores. What begins as a simple request soon spirals into conflict, revealing ego, sacrifice, and the true cost of partnership in marriage.

programme.title: One Day One Trouble
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose when Ego, a troublemaker, visits her brother's house and causes problems in his relationship.

programme.title: Ghost Baby
programme.desc: A group of mischievous ghosts, led by a child, haunts a community causing mayhem everywhere, while dealing with their own supernatural issues.

programme.title: The Weekend
programme.desc: A woman discovers a heart-breaking secret. She plans a steamy intimate weekend with her husband, but this weekend is full of questions, anger, rage and blood. She will not stop until she gets her answers.

programme.title: AMC Red Carpet - A Land Apart
